'''Narkina'''<ref name="DRVG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a [[gas giant]]<ref name="Narkina 5 Audio" /> located in the [[Abrion sector]]'s [[Narkina system]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> specifically at [[Standard Galactic Grid]] space S-15.<ref name="CLNE" /> The [[planet]] also lay in the section of [[Realspace|space]] known as [[The Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> Appearing [[Color|brown]] from space, Narkina had at least five [[moon]]s,<ref name="One Way Out" /> one of which was the [[water]] moon [[Narkina 5]], on which the [[Galactic Empire]] maintained a [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison complex]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Narkina 5" />
